gaps: Every breath-one loop was written as own output plus an addition, and sorted by the addition: nothing, the carrier's changes, a rule, an error sum, the world's pressure, the world at an instant, the world under rules, by physics, on request, and by time. Pressing on Laundered echo, own output returning under another's signature, showed that the map had no place for the mirror, another's output returning as one's own, and the climb's spend level does exactly that by counting every line in a shared ledger directory as a breath of its own. Pressing on Clock, the only return with nothing of the reasoner in it, showed that a return can be built to subtract the reasoner on purpose. This produced the changed question for breath two: what is the return made of, who labelled it, and can the reasoner be taken out of it.
accepted: Empty return: the loop returns nothing and the reasoner supplies the reading, since a null from an environment that answered none and a null from a probe that never touched its target arrive as the same empty string; the carrier is any query whose null result is legal, a search that matched nothing, a listing of the wrong path, a poll of a queue, a question nobody answered; what the environment adds is nothing, which is the whole difficulty, since the reasoner cannot tell whether nothing was added or nothing was asked; the latency is the probe's and it can be re-asked freely, and the same probe returns the same nothing; the degenerate closure is reading the void as a finding, no members, no changes, no objection, consent, and the operator's rule that another agent's silence is never the user's consent exists because this closure is common; the tell is a return with no denominator, no count of what was searched and no evidence that the probe touched anything, and the changed move is to put the same probe to a case whose answer is known to be nonempty before believing its none; observed, including in this map's own making, where a search for a record by name returned nothing because the key on disk was written with a space the pattern lacked. Not enumeration-stalls' Never met one, where the enumerator's experience ran out, since here the environment was asked and the answer is void.

Read back from disk: the reasoner's output returns as the bytes actually on disk, read later by the same reasoner, and the environment adds the difference between what was meant and what was written, the truncation, the shell's expansion of a token the reasoner took as literal, the here-document that interpolated a dollar sign, the overwrite a concurrent writer made in between; the carrier is the file system; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked freely with an identical answer until something writes; the degenerate closure is not re-reading, so the reasoner quotes its memory of the write as the state of the file and the read is of its own intent rather than of the disk; the tell is that the reasoner can cite the file's contents without having opened it since it wrote them; observed, as the line of five equals signs meant as a separator that the shell read as a command lookup and returned as not found. Not window-successions' file, which a stranger reads; here the writer reads it and the only loss is what the carrier changed on the way down and back.

Answered a different question: the carrier parses the ask under its own grammar before the environment answers, so the return is a true answer to a question the reasoner did not put; the carrier is a shell that expands, a pattern language in which a dot is any character, a comparison with a null that is never true, an index that stems the word, a form that cuts the field at forty characters; what the environment adds is correct and irrelevant; the latency and re-ask are the tool's, and re-asking in the same words reproduces the substitution exactly, which is the tell: the answer is stable, plausible, and does not vary with the part of the ask that mattered; the degenerate closure is reading that stability as the world's; the changed move is to put, through the same carrier, a question whose answer is already known and see whether it comes back; observed. Not Empty return, where nothing comes back, since here a full answer comes back to the wrong question, and the two meet only where the rewritten ask matches nothing.

Green by construction: the reasoner writes both the artifact and the check that reads it, so the check returns the artifact's behaviour as its specification and passes on the day it is written by construction; the carrier is a test suite derived from the implementation, a golden file recorded from the current output, an acceptance criterion written after the work; what the environment adds is nothing today and persistence later, since the check will report when the behaviour changes, which is real information, so the loop is worth nothing on the first day and something on the ninetieth; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked without limit; the degenerate closure is green read as correct; the tell is a check that has never been red and a failing case that nobody can name; the changed move is one case written from the requirement without looking at the code, run first; observed. Not Kept over before, where the verdict can still move and the denominator cannot; here the verdict itself was fixed when the check was derived.

Kept over before: a pass that may only cut reports a ratio whose denominator the rule fixed, so the number reads as a measurement and is a restatement of the rule; the carrier is the ledger line's keep rate, kept over candidates, where the repair breath's candidates are set equal to the items before it because it may not add; what the environment adds is at most the cuts, so the ratio is bounded at one and cannot rise, and in the observed ledgers 35 of the 38 repair breaths sit at 1.00 and three at 0.94 from a single cut each; the latency is zero and re-asking returns the same number; the degenerate closure lies downstream, since the climb's target picker reads each list's last keep rate as its gradient and skips the regate lines on the stated ground that survival is not growth yield, but not the repair lines, so 35 of 81 lists present a gradient of 1.00 that no growth measured and outrank every list whose last honest rate was 0.56 or 0.89; the tell is a returned number with almost no variance across cases, since a world would have scattered it; the changed move is the filter the picker already applies to one author, applied to the other; observed. Not Green by construction, where the verdict is fixed; here the verdict can move and only the ceiling is the rule's.

Closed traverse: the reasoner walks a loop back to its own starting point and the environment returns the sum of its errors as the gap between where it stands and where it began; the carrier is the surveyor's traverse closing on the first station, the trial balance whose debits must meet its credits, the checksum, the quantity converted to another unit and back; what the environment adds is the one number the reasoner could not compute leg by leg, the accumulated error, with no indication of which leg carried it; the latency is the length of the loop and it can be re-asked by walking again; the degenerate closure is distributing the misclosure across the legs by rule and reporting the adjusted loop, which closes exactly by construction, so an exact closure reads as accuracy, and in the books the same closure is the compensating error, two mistakes that cancel and leave the balance sound; the tell is a closure that is exact rather than small; observed. Adds to Green by construction what a self-consistency check needs in order to carry information: two paths made independently, which the traverse's legs are and the test derived from the code is not.

Own footprint: the reasoner's act moves the quantity it reads, so the return is the world plus the reasoner's own pressure, inseparably; the carrier is the price after the order, the poll after the campaign, the metric after the announcement, the queue after the poll of it; what the environment adds is everyone else's acts, mixed with the reasoner's in a proportion it does not know; the latency runs from milliseconds to days and it can be re-asked, but every ask is an act that moves it again; the degenerate closure is reading the move the reasoner caused as information about what it was measuring, the momentum that was its own order, the interest that was its own broadcast; the tell is that the move reverses when the reasoner stops; observed, as the temporary and permanent components of market impact. Not Laundered echo, where the reasoner's output comes back under someone else's signature; here it comes back under none.

Laundered echo: the reasoner's output leaves through one channel and returns through another with its origin stripped, so it reads as independent corroboration; the carrier is a claim placed in an encyclopedia, printed by a newspaper that read it there, and then cited by the encyclopedia to the newspaper; one defector's report reaching an analyst through three liaison services as three reports; a summary an agent wrote, quoted by a colleague, read back by the agent as the colleague's finding; a fleet's maps read by the next fleet's author as the shape of the subject rather than the shape of the fleet; what the environment adds is a second signature and a delay, and what it strips is the first signature; the latency is days to years and each re-ask multiplies the copies; the degenerate closure is the mechanism itself; the tell is that the corroborating source's wording matches the reasoner's own, and that the count of independent sources falls to one when traced; observed in circular reporting and in citation loops, and speculative for the fleet case, which this map cannot measure from inside. Not enumeration-stalls' Two nets, one boat, where two enumerators miss the same members for the same reason; here one enumerator's members return as a second enumerator's.

Lagged gauge: the return arrives after the reasoner has already acted again, so it reads a state it has since changed and corrects a correction; the carrier is a dashboard that aggregates on a delay, a stock report a month behind the orders, the pipe between a shower's tap and its head; what the environment adds is the true state at a past instant; the latency is the mechanism, and it can be re-asked, always late by the same amount; the degenerate closure is chasing one's own previous correction, so that an oscillation with a period near twice the lag is read as the world's volatility; the tell is the period; observed, as the bullwhip in a supply chain and the overshoot of any controller fed a delayed measurement. Not Clock, since the clock is what makes the lag a number; without a clock read beside the gauge the lag is invisible and the oscillation has no cause.

Compiler's list: the reasoner's whole text returns as a list of its consequences under rules the reasoner holds only in part, at once and in seconds; the carrier is a compiler, a type checker, a linter, a proof assistant, a schema validator; what the environment adds is consequence at a distance, the change on line three that fails line four hundred, under rules the reasoner had not internalized and could not have run in its head over the whole; the latency is seconds, it can be re-asked without limit, and it is deterministic, so re-asking with nothing changed is pure echo; the degenerate closure is editing to the error's text rather than to its cause, the cast that silences the type error, the annotation that satisfies the checker, the suppression comment, so that the next return is the reasoner's own decision and compiles is read as correct; the tell is a fix that changed the annotation and not the value; observed. Adds to denominator-manufactures' Compiler's catalogue, which takes the error list as a universe to count against, the loop's question: whether the list still comes from the rules or from the reasoner's edit of what the rules are shown.

Ping: the reasoner emits solely to get a return, and the environment adds range and shape by what it does to the emission; the carrier is sonar, radar, a health-check request, a canary release, an order for one share, a trial balloon; what the environment adds is time of flight, attenuation, and what bounced, none of which the reasoner could know before emitting; the latency is the distance and it can be re-asked at will; the degenerate closure is reverberation, reading the multipath echoes of one's own ping as targets and the wall one is standing beside as an object in the field; the tell is a target that moves when the reasoner moves; observed. Not Own footprint, where the act was for its own sake and moved the world; here the act is the question, and the reasoner would not have emitted if it did not want the answer.

Pull, not push: the environment changes without telling the reasoner and returns its state only when asked, so the reasoner is late by exactly as long as it went without asking; the carrier is a repository others push to, a shared file, a database, a mailbox with no notification; what the environment adds is what others did since the last ask; the latency is unbounded until the ask and seconds after it, and it can be re-asked freely; the degenerate closure is reading the last snapshot as the live state, the tree's status taken at the start of a session read as the tree now; the tell is that the answer the reasoner holds is older than its own last act on the thing; observed. Not Lagged gauge, where the environment is late; here the environment is current and the reasoner is late, so the cure is not a faster gauge but a habit of asking before acting.

Clock: the loop that always answers and never the same, in which the reasoner's act is stamped and the return is the elapsed time since, which no record of the reasoner's own can hold, since a reasoner does not feel its own duration; the carrier is the wall clock and the timestamps on the ledger; what the environment adds is elapsed time and the true order of events, which memory reorders; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked without limit, each answer different; the degenerate closure is computing now from one's own last stamp, so that the clock is read against the record instead of the record against the clock, and a paused reasoner resumes believing no time has passed; the tell is a clock that agrees with the record exactly; observed, as the session resumed after an hour that acts on a state it last saw before the hour. Not Pull, not push, where what changed is others' acts; here nothing may have changed but the time, and the time is enough to make the last read stale.

residue.item: Exit code: a tool's status code read as whether the reasoner's intent was met.
residue.why: Merged into Compiler's list and Empty return; the code is a rule's verdict on the tool's own question and adds no carrier that the two do not already show.

residue.item: Trial balance: the books that must balance and can still be wrong everywhere.
residue.why: Merged into Closed traverse as its bookkeeping case, since the compensating error is the same closure as the adjusted misclosure, an exact closure read as accuracy.

residue.item: Destructive test: the specimen consumed by the ask, so the second ask is of a different specimen.
residue.why: Held for breath two; it is one reason a loop cannot be re-asked, and the fresh critic is another, and the two may be one mechanism, spent freshness, or two, spent specimen and spent reader.

residue.item: Howl: a microphone before its own speaker, gain above one and a delay that sets the pitch.
residue.why: Merged into Lagged gauge, where the delay is the mechanism and the period is the tell; the acoustic case adds the gain condition, which is kept as the edge's antecedent rather than as an item.

residue.item: Subagent's summary: a reasoner's own brief returning as its subagent's report.
residue.why: Rejected as an item here; what a subagent's summary strips is window-successions' question, and what returns to the parent is Laundered echo where the parent's brief comes back as the child's finding.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a working reasoner sits in several of these loops at once, and a single tool result can be Answered a different question and Empty return in one string; the list makes no claim to cover every kind of loop.

The seriation is an itinerary of what the return is made of, not a ranking of latency, trust, or cost; the map edges are conditional authored claims, and the fork, the two passages, the loop, and the incompatibility they draw are interpretations.

The cases from this repo (the keep rate of the repair breath, the picker's filter, the spend level over a shared ledger directory, the 38 critic verdicts, the measure-and-name split in seriation) are read from ledgers and source as they stood on 2026-09-13 and may be repaired after this map is written; the outside cases (circular reporting, citation loops, market impact, the compass rule, the bullwhip, double blinding) are simplified to one mechanism each.

Out by the declared type: a reasoner re-reading its own context with nothing outside it, since no environment adds anything; an input the reasoner's output did not cause, the user's fresh instruction, the alert nobody asked for, which is input and not return; and what one reasoner leaves for a successor that never shares its context, which is window-successions. In only where the reasoner's own act went out and something came back to the same reasoner.

Neighbouring maps in this fleet: enumeration-stalls holds the stall mistaken for exhaustion, whose twin here is Empty return, the void mistaken for a none; context-horizons holds what lies past the edge of the window, where Pull, not push holds what lies in the environment until asked; composition-yields holds what crossing between passes yields, where Once and Blinded return hold what the single return of a judge can and cannot carry; denominator-manufactures' Compiler's catalogue takes the error list as a universe, where Compiler's list takes it as a return that an edit can corrupt.

gaps: The changed question yielded returns that are not own output plus an addition: others' lines counted as own (Shared ledger), the reasoner subtracted from the return by design (Blinded return), a reply that carries only a signature on the reasoner's proposal (Leading question), and a reader who was never given the reasoner and cannot be asked twice (Once), which the first framing could not hold because it assumed the return was always the reasoner's own with something added. The of-sentence now walks from nothing to the reasoner subtracted on purpose; the seriation gained its second run, the mixture, from self mislabelled as other to other mislabelled as self; and the edges gained the incompatibility between a blinded return and an informed one, on which the atlas's own repair seat sits.
accepted: Leading question: the reasoner asks the user in a form that contains its own proposal, so the reply returns a signature on the reasoner's output and not the thing the user knew; the carrier is the yes-or-no question, the shall-I-proceed, the draft presented for approval; what the environment could have added, intent, is exactly what the form excluded, and what it adds instead is authority; the latency is hours and it can be re-asked at a cost that rises with each ask, since the asker spends the user's patience; the degenerate closure is the ok read as an instruction, and its formal twin is the rule that questions are not instructions, which exists because the closure is common; the tell is a reply shorter than the question; the changed move is to ask for what the user knows and the reasoner does not, the constraint, the preference, the fact, rather than for a signature; analytical, with the doctrine observed. Not Once, where the reader was chosen for having no stake; here the reader is the one whose stake the reasoner needed and the form threw it away.

Shared ledger: the environment returns a record to which others also write, and the reasoner counts their lines as its own because the record does not say whose they are; the carrier is an append-only log with a shared name, a metric that several processes increment, a queue several workers drain; what the environment adds is others' output, unlabelled; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked; the degenerate closure is the reasoner reading others' work as its own spend, its own progress, or its own history, and the observed case is the climb's spend level, a decayed sum over the timestamps of every line in its ledger directory, where 76 fieldwork lines and 38 repair lines written by the fieldwork and repair passes sit beside the machine's own and each counts as a breath the machine took; the tell is a rate of one's own activity that moves when one is idle; the changed move is a by-field read before the line is counted; observed by reading the code, not by watching it stall. The mirror of Laundered echo, where one's own output returns as others'; here others' returns as one's own, and a reasoner in both loops at once cannot tell which way it is being fooled.

Once: a reader with no memory of the reasoner's reasoning returns a verdict on the text alone, and the ask spends the freshness, so the same question cannot be put again, since the second reader has seen the first verdict or the first reader is no longer fresh; the carrier is the fresh-context critic, the specimen consumed by a destructive test, the first user who will never again not know the product; what the environment adds is what the text says without what the author meant; the latency is minutes to hours; the degenerate closure has two forms, the seat's menu returning its attractor, as the 38 critiques across three fleets that all returned admit-with-repairs, which the author read as the map's grade, and the correction of that, a brief that tells the critic the fact so that the critic now avoids the attractor because told, which is a second echo wearing the first's cure; the tell of spent freshness is a verdict that cites the previous verdict; observed. Not Blinded return, where the reader is stripped of the author's expectation by design and can be re-run on a new arm; here the reader is stripped by never having had it, and there is no new arm.

Blinded return: the loop is built so that the return cannot carry the reasoner's expectation, since the reasoner is removed from the part of the environment that decides; the carrier is the double-blind trial, the judge who sees candidates without their proposer, the seriation whose order is measured by one process while its axis is named by another, the review with the author's name cut off; what the environment adds is the outcome independent of hope; what it costs is that the return cannot carry intent either, so a blinded judge can say whether the text holds and not whether the target was preserved; the latency is the trial's, months, and it cannot be re-asked on the same arm, since once the blind is broken the loop is closed for that specimen; the degenerate closure is unblinding by tell, the side effect that reveals the arm, the voice that reveals the author, so that the return quietly carries the expectation again; the tell is a blinded read that agrees with the unblinded one on cases where the arm was guessable; observed. Not Once, where the reader was never given the author's reasoning; here the reader may have everything but the one thing, and the mechanism is the subtraction, which can be repeated on a new arm.

residue.item: Destructive test: the specimen consumed by the ask.
residue.why: Merged into Once as its physical case, since spent specimen and spent reader are one mechanism, the ask consumes the condition that made the return worth having, and neither has a second arm; the double blind, which does have a second arm, went to Blinded return instead.

residue.item: Self-citation: the reasoner citing its own earlier paper as a source.
residue.why: Merged into Laundered echo as the case where the reasoner strips its own signature knowingly; no distinct carrier.

residue.item: Alarm read as instruction: the scheduled alert that fires and is treated as a command.
residue.why: Rejected by the boundary: the alert was not caused by the reasoner's output, so it is input and not return, and its confusion with a command is a reading error without a loop.

residue.item: Reasoner's own style returning as house style: an author's sentence shapes adopted by the catalog and read back as the register's demand.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: it sits between Laundered echo and Shared ledger, own form returning as the institution's rule, and it needs a carrier of its own that is not the catalog's brief; every instance found so far is Laundered echo with the fleet as the second channel, which the wild priority is written to test.

neighbors.separating_case: Two checks are run over the same map on the same afternoon. The first is a golden file recorded from the record as it stands, run again; it is green, and it will be green until the record changes, and on the day it is recorded it can tell nobody anything about the map. The second is the repair breath's keep rate over the same record; the repairer cuts one item that restated its neighbour and the rate reads 0.94. The number moved, so it is not Green by construction, and yet it could not have read 1.05, since the pass may not add, so its ceiling is the rule's and a downstream reader who sees 1.00 on 35 other maps is reading the ceiling. A reasoner who confuses them either trusts the ratio because it moved, or distrusts the golden file on the ninetieth day when it finally has something to say. The tell that separates them is whether the return can move at all, and in which direction: the verdict that cannot move is Green by construction, and the number that can move only down is Kept over before.

checks.boundary_case: The tempting nonmember is a reasoner re-reading its own earlier turns, its scratch notes still in the window, its own plan: nothing outside it adds anything, and the reading is memory, not return, so it is out by the declared type, and the moment the notes are written to disk and read back they are in as Read back from disk, since the carrier now adds the difference between what was meant and what was kept. The second tempting nonmember is an input the reasoner's output did not cause, the user's fresh instruction, an alert that fires on a schedule; it is input and it may be signal, but it is not the reasoner's act coming back, so it is out, and Clock sits on that fence and is in, since the return is elapsed time since the reasoner's own stamp and would not exist without the act. The third is the handoff to a successor that never shares the context, which is window-successions; the fence is whether the same reasoner reads what it wrote.
checks.form_inference: The map shows that a degenerate closure is a property of a route and not of a loop, since every one of its edges is a way of walking from an honest return into an echo by one edit, one report, or one hand-over. It shows a fork at Compiler's list, where the edit that changes the value keeps the return the rules' and the edit that changes what the checker is shown turns it into Green by construction while it still looks like the compiler's. It shows a passage of two levels, Closed traverse to Kept over before to Shared ledger, in which the only self-consistency return that carries a number the reasoner could not compute becomes, when the raw gap is adjusted away, a restatement of a rule, and that rule, once written into a ledger a second loop reads, becomes the second loop's measured world, so the climb ranks 35 repaired maps by a number that no growth produced. It shows a loop between Lagged gauge and Own footprint, which closes only where the reasoner's own acts are large against the world's, and then gives the oscillation its period. It shows a passage at Once to Laundered echo, where a fresh reader handed the author's self-read returns the author's verdict under the reader's signature, so freshness is spent by what the reader is given and not by the ask. And it shows an incompatibility between Blinded return and Leading question: a return cannot be both blind to the reasoner's expectation and informed of the reasoner's intent, so the judge who is asked whether the target was preserved must be told the target, and what it is told is the author's output; the atlas's repair rule, which has the critic set target preservation from the of-sentence, sits exactly on this edge, and the map says the seat cannot be made clean, only honest about which side of the edge it stands on.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a distinct loop, its carrier, what the environment adds, its latency and re-askability, and its degenerate closure with a tell; the strange members (a void read as a none, a number that can move only down, a closure exact by construction, one's own order read as momentum, one's own claim read as corroboration, others' lines counted as one's own spend, a blinded judge that cannot rule on intent) are kept as mechanisms and not softened into advice about verifying work.

next_crossfield_opening: Loops that label their mixture: connect Own footprint, Shared ledger, and Laundered echo with witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form, and ask what must exist on the carrier for a return to say whose it is, a by-field, a signature, an order identifier, a citation chain, so that the three mixture loops become one loop with three states of one label, and the census undercount's post-enumeration survey, which asks the environment to count the counters, becomes the model for a picker that reads the by-field before it reads the number.

gaps: The anchor observed case, the climb's picker skipping regate lines but not repair lines, was stale in the tree by the map's own Pull, not push: commit 809dd01 added repair lines to the filter at 2026-09-13T15:33:23Z, forty-five seconds after breath two, so the present-tense claim in Kept over before, its edge to Shared ledger, the near priority, the form inference, and the mode was false at critique time; the mechanism, a rule-fixed denominator with a ceiling of one, survives and the case now carries its commit and is checkable only at that commit's parent. Second defect: Read back from disk's only observed case, the equals-sign separator, never touched disk; zsh took the word as a command-path request, which is Answered a different question, where the case now sits.
accepted: Read back from disk: the reasoner's output returns as the bytes actually on disk, read later by the same reasoner, and the environment adds the difference between what was meant and what was written, the truncation, the shell's expansion of a token the reasoner took as literal, the here-document that interpolated a dollar sign, the overwrite a concurrent writer made in between; the carrier is the file system; the latency is seconds and it can be re-asked freely with an identical answer until something writes; the degenerate closure is not re-reading, so the reasoner quotes its memory of the write as the state of the file and the read is of its own intent rather than of the disk; the tell is that the reasoner can cite the file's contents without having opened it since it wrote them; observed, as the unquoted here-document whose body the shell expands before the bytes reach the file, so the read returns a variable's value where the reasoner wrote its name, and the file the reasoner remembers writing was never on disk. Not window-successions' file, which a stranger reads; here the writer reads it and the only loss is what the carrier changed on the way down and back.

Answered a different question: the carrier parses the ask under its own grammar before the environment answers, so the return is a true answer to a question the reasoner did not put; the carrier is a shell that expands, a pattern language in which a dot is any character, a comparison with a null that is never true, an index that stems the word, a form that cuts the field at forty characters; what the environment adds is correct and irrelevant; the latency and re-ask are the tool's, and re-asking in the same words reproduces the substitution exactly, which is the tell: the answer is stable, plausible, and does not vary with the part of the ask that mattered; the degenerate closure is reading that stability as the world's; the changed move is to put, through the same carrier, a question whose answer is already known and see whether it comes back; observed, as the line of equals signs meant as a separator that the shell took for a request for a command's path, since a word beginning with an equals sign is one under its grammar, and answered, correctly, that no such command exists. Not Empty return, where nothing comes back, since here a full answer comes back to the wrong question, and the two meet only where the rewritten ask matches nothing.

Kept over before: a pass that may only cut reports a ratio whose denominator the rule fixed, so the number reads as a measurement and is a restatement of the rule; the carrier is the ledger line's keep rate, kept over candidates, where the repair breath's candidates are set equal to the items before it because it may not add; what the environment adds is at most the cuts, so the ratio is bounded at one and cannot rise, and in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 35 of the 38 repair breaths sat at 1.00 and three at 0.94 from a single cut each; the latency is zero and re-asking returns the same number; the degenerate closure lies downstream and was live in the climb's target picker until commit 809dd01, forty-five seconds after this map's second breath: the picker read each list's last keep rate as its gradient and skipped the regate lines on the stated ground that survival is not growth yield, but not the repair lines, so 35 of 81 lists presented a gradient of 1.00 that no growth measured and outranked every list whose last honest rate was 0.56 or 0.89; the tell is a returned number with almost no variance across cases, since a world would have scattered it; the changed move is the filter the picker applied to one author, applied to the other, which is the one string comparison that commit added; observed, and repaired within the hour, so the case is checkable only at that commit's parent. Not Green by construction, where the verdict is fixed; here the verdict can move and only the ceiling is the rule's.

Own footprint: the reasoner's act moves the quantity it reads, so the return is the world plus the reasoner's own pressure, inseparably; the carrier is the price after the order, the poll after the campaign, the metric after the announcement, the queue after the poll of it; what the environment adds is everyone else's acts, mixed with the reasoner's in a proportion it does not know; the latency runs from milliseconds to days and it can be re-asked, but every ask is an act that moves it again; the degenerate closure is reading the move the reasoner caused as information about what it was measuring, the momentum that was its own order, the interest that was its own broadcast; the tell is the part of the move that reverses when the reasoner stops, which was the reasoner's own, while the part that stays is the world's or the information the act leaked, and the two cannot be told apart until the reasoner stops; observed, as the temporary and permanent components of market impact. Not Laundered echo, where the reasoner's output comes back under someone else's signature; here it comes back under none.

Ping: the reasoner emits solely to get a return, and the environment adds range and shape by what it does to the emission; the carrier is sonar, radar, a health-check request, a canary release, an order for one share, a trial balloon; what the environment adds is time of flight, attenuation, and what bounced, none of which the reasoner could know before emitting; the latency is the distance and it can be re-asked at will; the degenerate closure is reverberation, reading the multipath echoes of one's own ping as targets and the wall one is standing beside as an object in the field; the tell is a return whose range does not change as the reasoner moves, the hull, the wall it carries with it, or one that sits at a whole multiple of a known reflector's range; observed. Not Own footprint, where the act was for its own sake and moved the world; here the act is the question, and the reasoner would not have emitted if it did not want the answer.

Shared ledger: the environment returns a record to which others also write, and the reasoner counts their lines as its own because the record does not say whose they are; the carrier is an append-only log with a shared name, a metric that several processes increment, a queue several workers drain; what the environment adds is others' output, unlabelled; the latency is zero and it can be re-asked; the degenerate closure is the reasoner reading others' work as its own spend, its own progress, or its own history, and the observed case is the climb's spend level, a decayed sum over the timestamps of every line in its ledger directory, where, in the ledgers as committed on 2026-09-13, 76 fieldwork lines and 38 repair lines written by the fieldwork and repair passes sit beside the machine's own and each counts as a breath the machine took; the tell is a rate of one's own activity that moves when one is idle; the changed move is a by-field read before the line is counted; observed by reading the code, not by watching it stall. The mirror of Laundered echo, where one's own output returns as others'; here others' returns as one's own, and a reasoner in both loops at once cannot tell which way it is being fooled.
residue: No item cut. Lagged gauge preserved as written: the critic noted its period figure, near twice the lag, is the relay-control figure and that proportional control runs two to four times the dead time, and permitted but did not require widening; 'near' was judged to cover it. Shared ledger kept with its counts dated to the tree as committed on 2026-09-13 on the critic's modality note, since ledgerLevel still reads no by-field at HEAD and the mechanism is live.
limits: Repo cases are dated: the picker defect is checkable only at the parent of commit 809dd01, and the counts 35 of 38, 35 of 81, 76 fieldwork and 38 repair lines are of the tree as committed on 2026-09-13; the working tree at critique time already held 39 of 42, 85, 84, and 42.
This breath's own keep rate is the item's ceiling of one, and the climb's picker now skips this line by the commit the map named.
seed: The reflexive case this map fell into and does not contain: a reasoner's return that changes the environment it described because it was read, so the observation is falsified by being made. The picker defect this map named was fixed forty-five seconds after the map's second breath, almost certainly because the map named it, so the atlas would have admitted a present-tense observation of a state its own admission ended. It sits between Own footprint (the act moves what it measures) and Laundered echo (own output returns through another channel), and its carrier is missing: what an item would have to carry (a commit hash, a ledger stamp, a denominator dated to the tree) so that a repo case stays checkable after the repo repairs it. The near-term experiment is cheap: for every repo case in the 38 admitted maps, check whether the cited code or ledger still exhibits it at HEAD, and count how many were repaired by the fleet that observed them.
